The '''Santheria system''' was located in the [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] known as [[Santherian tenho-root]].<ref name="MedStar" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Santheria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
